categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches transaction orphanage handling in src/node/txorphanage.{cpp,h} under the P2P area label.
categories.rationale: Prevents a node abort when peer counts exceed 3,000 announcing orphans. Integer division by the peer count produces an allowance of zero, triggering an assertion failure in GetDosScore() during trimming that terminates the process on nodes configured for high peer counts.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The changes to unit and fuzz tests solely exercise the orphanage fix rather than modifying test framework infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Tests of a specific P2P component belong to P2P rather than test infrastructure.
